notes.title: Update Information on 22nd February
notes.content:
Dear all, we have fixed some bugs and optimized the game according to players’ feedback and suggestions. Hope you can have more smooth and happier game experience. Here is the update information:

【Optimization content】
1. Optimize the process of the juvenile palace in the distribution box did not take away the tape caused by abnormal problems
2. Optimize the auto-play function of the dialogue of storyline.
-Default off autoplay
-Click C in the dialogue to open the auto-play function, Click C again to turn off the autoplay function
-Autoplay is turned on after the end of each sentence 3S automatically play the next sentence
3. Optimize the character space in individual text
4. Optimize the inconsistent rhythm of voice and character opening animation in individual scenes
5. Optimize individual scene mapping

【Bug fixes】
1. Repair the problem of inconsistent pictures in the secondary and primary interfaces of individual scenes
2. Repair the problem of cell phone appearing in backpack and prop bar at the same time under special circumstances.
3. Repair the problem that the game failure will continue to trigger the broken bridge plot before entering the broken bridge in the final chapter
4. Repair the problem of abnormal order of individual statements in the dialogue of ten lies in the final chapter.
5. Repair the problem that the bookstore in chapter 4 abnormally skips the plot of the first visit to Zhang Dongsheng's house after completing the set of words under special circumstances.
6. Repair the problem of failure to read the game after saving the game before the knife Zhang Dongsheng in the final chapter under special circumstances.
7. Repair the problem of abnormal disappearance of cell phone under special circumstances in chapter 4.
8. Repair the problem that the alarm clock is closed but the alarm is still ringing after reading the file under special circumstances.
9. Repair the problem that the interaction button does not appear under special circumstances.

【Tips】
	We have received all the feedbacks under the post. However, we can not reply the comments due to the Steam system setting. We will reply all the comments by private messages. You can also send an email to alubastudio@163.com to contact us and give feedback.

	Thanks for giving us kindly feedback and offering the problems. We will continually optimize the game to provide players’ happier and better experience.

notes.title: The Bad Kids is Officially on Sale!丨 Update Information of Demo Version
notes.content:
There’s the good news that The Bad Kids is officially on sale! Thanks for all your patience and support! We have received a lot of precious feedback and advice since the demo version released. After half a year of hard work developing and optimizing, we have finally made it! Hope you enjoy it in the game~

      The Bad Kids is priced at 56 RMB, and a 15% discount is set for the first week (double weeks). Welcome having a try! At the meantime, the store page also launches a bundled package with the game Cyber Manhunt. If you have purchased Cyber Manhunt before, you can get higher discount~

      The mac version and the gamepad support are still on the process. We recommend you play it by windows system and operate with keyboard and mouse. Please pay attention to the update later. Thanks a lot!

      Finally, although the options in the game are limited, the options in the real life are infinite. Wishing you a world of happiness and love as all your dreams come true.


【Update Information of Demo Version】
1.Changing the dubbing of the characters, making it consistent with the official version.
2.Optimizing the scene light effect of demo version, making it consistent with the official version.

[b]IMPORTANT: If you find a bug or have some advice, please send an email to let us know[/b]

	From the production team of The Bad Kid

notes.title: Written on the day before game release
notes.content:
[b]This is the important information of The Bad Kids:[/b]
-The game is priced at US$7.99, with 15% discount last to 31st January.
- The Bad Kids and Cyber Manhunt will launch a bundle sale, which means players who purchased Cyber Manhunt before can get more discount.
-it is only supported by windows version. The mac version is in preparation, which is estimated be on sale one month later.
-Gamepad operation is not available. There are some problems with the adaptation of the gamepad which needs more time to solve. To have better experience, we recommend you use mouse and keyboard to play.
IMPORTANT: If you find a bug or have some advice, please send  an email to let us know

[b]Whether the save record of demo version will be inherited in official version?[/b]
-The save record of demo version can not be inherited in official version because there are a lot of changes between them. All the players should start the game from the beginning.

[b]Will there be DLC in the future?[/b]
-We have been considering the DLC in the future. However, limited by the human resource, we can only resolve all the problems step by step.

[b]About the ending[/b]
-There are multiple endings. Conditions of triggering some endings are relatively strict. Welcome exploring all the endings!

[b]About the bonus [/b]
-There are some bonus  set in the game, which do not effect the whole experience and the rhyme of the plot. Explore them!

[b]About the timeline:[/b]
-After the demo version, we have received many feedbacks. We have been struggling for a long time to choose better scheme. The joke that the production team is going bald is not just because of staying up late. To be honest, this is our first time try to do the TV IP adaptation game that we always walking on the thin ice. We do not want to just dismantle the TV plot, nor do we want to be too far removed from the original work so that players can not understand it. In the demo version, you can find that the timelines of the game and the TV version are not completely consistent. The timeline of the game is temporarily under wraps~

[b]Appreciation:[/b]
Thanks for your following and supporting The Bad Kids all the time. No matter the player, anchors, media, platforms and other exploration teams, thanks for all your help throughout the process. It is our luck to meet you guys. Hope The Bad Kids can live up to your expectations!
